description: Legal / sworn-testimony domain: preferred WordNet sense per ambiguous form. The disambiguation prior the collapse equation consults when a sentence is linked to this domain library. Sense addresses are content-derived from the WordNet pack (stable across pools) and VERIFIED bound to the form. v0.2.0 adds role-ambiguous deposition-discourse terms (answer/talk/work/leave/question/abuse) — kept here, NOT in the general pack, because their dominant sense is corpus-dependent (e.g. 'work' is a verb in testimony but a noun 'the work' in a research corpus), so they should only be pinned when the legal domain is active.

confirm.gloss: establish or strengthen with new evidence

question.gloss: a sentence of inquiry asking for a reply
